The story

New hands, same camino

Regulars have been finding their way to this dining room for the better part of a decade.

Today El Camino is under new ownership — and the town has noticed. Reviewers say the new owners have “really taken it to a new level,” and on a good night the chef comes out from the kitchen to talk plates at the table. Longtime guests still ask for Jorge by name.
